rule: Deploy capital once into the best available opportunity set, then let incumbents compound. Rotate only when a challenger has a materially stronger acceleration edge than the incumbent HOLD state, or when the incumbent thesis/risk state is invalidated. No leverage; no real orders are executed.

power.summary: AI data-center demand is colliding with generation, grid, switchgear and cooling constraints.

cuas.summary: Drone proliferation is increasing demand for detection, autonomy, electronic warfare and counter-UAS effectors.

photonics.summary: AI clusters are pushing more bandwidth into optical links and photonic components as electrical interconnects hit power and distance limits.

physical.summary: AI is moving into robots and edge systems, but listed-company economic capture remains early and fragmented.
